follow_ups.title: A normal distribution open on one side in the tolerance and Sobol drivers
follow_ups.acceptance: erfc(+inf) is 0 and erfc(-inf) is 2 exactly (neither is a number now), and uq::run, sensitivity::run, design_uq and design_sobol sample a normal distribution with one finite and one open bound: every sample lies within the finite bound and equals the closed form of the truncated inverse CDF within a limit registered before the run; k1_one_open_side_known_miss of crates/rcfd-mcp/tests/design_uq_sobol_args_f339.rs passes with its limit unchanged; every result with two finite or two open bounds is bit-identical. Limits not stated here are registered before the run.
